verdict.rationale: Browser export is a fair axis for a game engine, but the pack has no first-party documentation of an HTML5, WebGL or WebGPU target, and nothing on payload size. The platform-publishing docs list device and console deployment only. The only related item is a 2015 community remark that version 4.7 could export to HTML5. That is not current documented capability and says nothing about WebGL, WebGPU or payload, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story
